notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal exactly two or three damage to a permanent or player.
description:
Cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication by paying {3}{U}, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Ghyrson Starn.
Deal exactly two or three damage to a permanent or player, which is reduced to one due to Ghosts of the Innocent.
Ghyrson Starn and the Ghyrson Starn token each trigger.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to that permanent or player due to Ghosts of the Innocent.
The Ghyrson Starn token triggers, dealing 1 damage to that permanent or player due to Ghosts of the Innocent.
Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to that permanent or player due to Ghosts of the Innocent.
 Repeat from step 5.
